greenhouse.note: Pause before final submit. Greenhouse forms are usually 3-4 screens.

lever.note: Lever forms are single-page and relatively clean.

workday.note: Workday is highly variable. Many steps, custom questions, auto-save quirks. Expect failures; fall back to manual.

idealist.note: Idealist usually redirects to org's own application form — detect and handle redirect.

indeed.note: Indeed Apply forms vary widely. Low cap; high manual review.

unknown.note: Unknown platform — always require manual approval.

note: All non-LinkedIn platforms require manual approval before submission. noVNC takeover URL is printed for review.
